# Contribution Guidelines

Thank you very much for your interest in this project.  
We welcome bug reports, feature and improvement suggestions, and inquiries from everyone.

Before contributing, please read the following guidelines and thank you for your cooperation.

## Introduction

You can contribute to this project in the following ways:

- Reporting bugs
- Proposing new features or improvements
- Inquiries

### Reporting Bugs (Issues)

If you find a bug, please create a new issue via the Issues page.

- Before creating an issue, please check to see if a similar issue has already been created.
- We provide a bug report template when creating an issue. Please fill it out according to each item in the template.
- It is very helpful if your bug report includes information on how to reproduce the issue.

### Feature Proposals and Improvement Suggestions (Issues)

If you have a feature proposal or improvement suggestion, please create a new issue via the Issues section.

- Before creating an issue, please check to see if a similar issue has already been created.
- We provide a template for feature proposals and improvement suggestions when creating an issue. Please fill out each section of the template.

### Inquiries (Issues)

  If you have questions or inquiries about the project, please create a new issue via the Issues section.

- Before creating an issue, please check to see if a similar issue has already been created.
- Please use the template for questions and inquiries when creating an issue.

## Submitting Code (Pull Requests)

We will triage the bug reports and suggestions you have submitted and aim to implement them.

Thank you for your understanding.

## Code of Conduct

We aim to foster a communication environment where all participants feel welcome and respected.  
Please treat other participants with respect and engage in constructive communication.  

Please read [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

While there are no restrictions on the language of communication, using English or Japanese will facilitate smoother communication.

If you have any questions, please feel free to contact [td_oss_support@capcom.com](mailto:td_oss_support@capcom.com).  
We look forward to your cooperation.
